mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a sell-off in equities within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST growth < 0.0% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST growth < 0.0% annually, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
